summary: Layout reconciliation after a falsification pass: the producer writes each circuit archive once, live_run.py yields its record I/O under one import name, caches leave the checkout, and four rule changes (snapshot dry run, one review round, cited-gates nightly, capture before claim) await the owner.

reconciliation.note: Every quantity in the design document is measured at a1d1743 (git ls-files, ci/gates.json, an import-graph scan with two 14-module strongly connected components) or read from the GitHub REST API on 2026-10-30 (60 merged PRs: 312 Codex requests, 142 threads, 110 fixes; 100 pr.yml runs: lint and types 0 failures, tests 13, gates 9; 9 scheduled audits: 8 failed, 12 of 16 red gates uncited; bare dry-run directories against live_run commits per day r = 0.87). Reviews by Codex gpt-daybreak-blue-latest, Grok Build and an owner-supplied third review were checked line by line; the falsification table in the document records which recommendations each one refuted.

scope: Producer-side slimming of results/live (content-addressed isa.qpy, allocation-search sidecar, the other digest-carrying duplicate groups); extraction of record and archive I/O from live_run.py under one import name with an import-boundary test; mypy cache and git maintenance outside the checkout; and, on the owner's word, the AGENTS.md rule changes the operating data refuted: live dry run per refactor, the repeat Codex round, the always-red nightly, the claim coupling of retention. Document moves, map ownership, subpackages, sparse profiles and a public data repository are deferred and recorded in the design document.
next_action: Owner answers the four decisions in docs/design/repository-layout-reconciliation.md; the archive store, sidecar, record I/O extraction and cache items proceed meanwhile.

steps.action: live_run.py writes each compiled archive once to results/live/archives/<sha256>.qpy and the allocation-search candidates to a sidecar; one verifying archive API in the run-record module serves the 48 readers and the IQM, Quandela, Kaggle and circuit.json duplicate groups
steps.acceptance: a dry run of an existing case writes no isa.qpy in its directory and a record under 2 MB; adjudication of a retained run reads its original bytes; the gates binding retained runs pass unchanged

steps.action: record and archive I/O (_write_once_atomically, _archived_entries, the archive API) leave live_run.py behind a stable module under one import name; live_run.py stays the CLI and facade; an import-boundary test rejects an edge back into live_run or either strongly connected component; compilation and planning follow when an active task touches them
steps.acceptance: mypy over the five code roots, the tests check and every reached gate pass; a snapshot dry run of a retained case is byte-identical to its record; the boundary test fails on an injected reverse edge

steps.action: ci/pinned_tool.py keys the mypy cache under ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/gororoba-quantum/; the canonical checkout registers git maintenance; pr.yml's stale 18 MiB comment names the measured pack
steps.acceptance: no .mypy_cache in a checkout after a gate run; loose objects under gc.auto after a day of commits

steps.action: live_run.py plans retained cases against docs/evidence/heron_platform/targets.json into a scratch directory and the tests check compares the record to the retained case; AGENTS.md reserves the live dry run for admission, approval, submission and readiness changes and every --submit
steps.acceptance: the snapshot dry run reproduces a retained case's record; a refactoring PR adds no results/live directory

steps.action: the pr.yml gates job runs every reached gate inside its budget longest first and reports an unfinished reached gate as pending; lint and types leave the branch-protection set; the nightly runs cited gates, the 12 uncited red gates get a claim or leave ci/gates.json, gates above 60 s run weekly and on input change through the ledger
steps.acceptance: the scheduled audit is green or names a claim; the gates summary reads RUN, REUSE and PENDING per gate

steps.action: AGENTS.md: one Codex round per PR; a PR with no thread merges on green checks after the operator reads the diff; a second round only when the operator review changed code
steps.acceptance: requests per merged PR fall from 5.2 toward 2 over the next 30 merges

steps.action: a retained run enters research_state.json with its ledger row and research_state.py no longer requires a citing claim; the claim is a later change
steps.acceptance: retain_run.sh followed by the registry check passes on a run with no claim

steps.action: the 74 inbox plan records are triaged to active or closed in one pass and the core-plan-tracker gate leaves the nightly blocking set; the root guide's cut to about 200 lines with the CI and review mechanics in runbooks is in progress on its own branch
steps.acceptance: no inbox record older than 14 days; the plan tracker gate is green or absent from the scheduled audit

steps.action: the owner answers the four rule changes (snapshot dry run, one review round, cited-gates nightly, capture before claim) in the design document
steps.acceptance: each answer recorded in the design document and the four rule steps unblocked or closed
